headline: Start with your *history*, not a blank page.
body: Bring your past meals, weigh-ins and steps into RLJ.
caption:
Start with your history, not a blank page.

Import your food diary from MyFitnessPal, and your weight, steps and training from Apple Health or Samsung Health. RLJ charts it from day one.

Record the whole journey, not just the weigh-in. rlj.app
